question: A customer asks for a refund on a damaged blender. Over three iterations, Claude's responses had stop_reason "tool_use" and requested get_customer, lookup_order, and process_refund, and your loop executed each tool and returned its result. Claude's fourth response has stop_reason "end_turn" and contains a message that confirms the refund to the customer. What should your agentic loop do with this fourth response?

options.text: Run process_refund a second time to verify the refund, and end the loop only after this extra tool call returns a success result.
options.reason: The loop executes tools only when Claude requests them with stop_reason "tool_use". Here Claude returned "end_turn", so the loop should simply terminate.

options.text: Call escalate_to_human so that a human agent confirms the refund, because the loop must end with a tool call rather than with text.
options.reason: Loop termination depends on stop_reason "end_turn", not on a final tool call. Claude did not request escalation, so the loop should not call that tool.

options.text: Send the conversation back to Claude and keep looping until a reply contains a closing phrase such as "anything else I can help with".
options.reason: The guide names parsing natural language signals to decide loop termination as an anti-pattern. The "end_turn" stop_reason is the stopping signal.

options.text: End the loop and deliver Claude's confirmation message to the customer, because the "end_turn" stop_reason means Claude has finished.
options.reason: The loop should continue while stop_reason is "tool_use" and terminate when it is "end_turn". This response is "end_turn", so the loop ends.
